title: How many bitcoins really are there?

The Fed prints how much money every day? And we wonder why inflation is a problem…

asr.full_text: If a Bitcoin was the size of a quarter all 21 million and that would fit inside a single shipping container But to fit the dollars that fed prints on average every day you'd need 72 shipping containers each year you'd need 26,000 280 containers and To fit what they've printed in the last decade But you need a lot more than that.
